proposed.explanation: Selling 200 shares of COMI at 128.00 EGP per share is recommended to meet your upcoming 30,000 EGP liquidity need within 6 months while partially reducing single-stock concentration. Currently, your portfolio consists of 5,000.00 EGP in cash and 1,000 shares of COMI worth 128,000.00 EGP (133,000.00 EGP total, or 96.2% in one stock), leaving a 25,000.00 EGP cash shortfall for your 6-month requirement. Selling at least 196 shares is required to raise 25,088.00 EGP, so selling 200 shares generates 25,600.00 EGP (before any transaction fees), increasing cash to 30,600.00 EGP and leaving 800 shares of COMI valued at 102,400.00 EGP (77.0% of the portfolio). On fundamentals, COMI reported strong FY2025 results, with net profit rising to 82,258,815,000 EGP in 2025 from 55,256,732,000 EGP in 2024, supported by net interest income of 107,699,631,000 EGP. Basic earnings per share reached 18.25 EGP in FY2025, implying a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of about 7.0x at 128.00 EGP, backed by consolidated customer deposits (due to customers) of 1,110,395,693,000 EGP and consolidated total equity and net profit for the year of 231,486,342,000 EGP as of December 31, 2025. Because the available financials are strong, a partial sale rather than a full exit preserves exposure while securing near-term cash, though retaining 77.0% of your portfolio in a single equity remains high risk for a retiree with low loss tolerance and a 1-3 year horizon. This guidance is not a guarantee of returns, and stock price volatility or stale FY2025 financials could affect outcomes.
